scope_note: Append-only audit log module — AuditPort with save() and findMany() only, admin list/filter/export
acceptance_criteria: AuditPort exposes only save() and findMany() — no update or delete at any layer
GET /api/admin/audit lists audit events with filters (actorId, action, resourceType, date range)
GET /api/admin/audit/export returns CSV of filtered events
Audit records are immutable — no endpoint or service modifies existing entries
